      Circle.rotate(float)
      Rotating a circle does not do anything geometrically, but the method is in an interface so i did not provide an actual method.
      Line.scale(float)
      Dilating each point in the line would scale only the y-intercept, which is not what I imagine people would use this function for. Use Line.scaleSlope(float) to scale the slope.
